subject.title: fix(cli-runner): use sender metadata in CLI session history user labels

question: Which durable sender-identity fields may become model-visible in CLI reseed history: the persisted trio from the current transcript contract, or an explicitly added `senderLabel` contract?
rationale: This chooses the trusted identity boundary for model-visible historical context; source inspection and tests cannot safely decide whether a new durable identity field is intended.

options.title: Use the persisted identity trio
options.body: Remove `senderLabel` from the renderer and tests, then retain the ordered `senderName`, `senderUsername`, and `senderId` fallback.

options.title: Adopt `senderLabel` as a durable contract
options.body: Define and persist `senderLabel` at every relevant transcript producer, document its trust semantics, and add cross-path proof before allowing the renderer to consume it.

recommendation.title: Use the persisted identity trio
recommendation.body: Remove `senderLabel` from the renderer and tests, then retain the ordered `senderName`, `senderUsername`, and `senderId` fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged durable sender-metadata boundary that this PR extends at the renderer.
